source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Sajeepan if its first-session utm_campaign exactly matches one of "Accessories_sj", "GCSS_ALL_ROAS_400_SAJEE_PMAX", "SJ_TOP_20X", "sajeepan_pmax_gcss_ceiling_rose_fitting_asset", "Shop_SJ_PMax-25", "Aji_Sh_PMax", "Shop_DM_PMax-25", "Klarna_P", "SJ_PMAX_Scale_Heroes_25", "KLARNA_CSS_SJ25_PMAX", "Klarna_G2" (case-insensitive), OR (first session has no campaign/term AND the 2nd session's campaign is "Klarna_P" — confirmed by the user, 2026-07-27). Checked only after DM-Ad, Meta and Sonya.. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Organic -> CPPC -> Thishoban) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. Standalone page, built 2026-07-27.
